title: Kinetic Press generated-quality roadmap v4
summary: Treat gold reader parity as the completed foundation; use its human visual feedback to calibrate a generated-equation quality envelope before expanding to geometry, SVG, code, providers, and cross-domain surfaces.

sourceRefs.intent: Adopt the generated-equation reliability phase and pipeline fixes, beginning with the remaining gold-card visual issues, before broadening to other exemplars.
sourceRefs.summary: Explicit approval for the revised roadmap frontier.
Approved predecessor that introduced generated-equation reliability.
Quantitative motion-quality evaluator to promote into the generated-output gate.
Semantic-only promotion boundary and typed repair protocol.
Responsive fit contract to evolve into timeline-wide typography and layout planning.

planRevision.objective: Deliver visually beautiful, scrollable, searchable, URL-addressable semantic cards whose coordinated motion remains smooth and trustworthy under generated content and controlled LLM editing, making Kinetic Press instantly distinct from static text, video, and conventional interactive lessons.

assumptions.statement: One canonical equation card must establish the architectural and interaction foundation before renderer breadth is valuable.
The accepted editor realization can be extracted behind neutral renderer contracts without coupling the semantic reader to the editor.
Reduced motion should retain essential explanatory movement while removing nonessential acceleration, depth, scale, and flourish; fully static presentation remains explicit.
Visual parity can be reached without sacrificing static prose, search, print, no-JavaScript output, exact scroll navigation, or precise URLs.

LLMs can safely edit semantic objects, transformations, correspondence, explanatory focus, and bounded presentation intent while deterministic compilers retain authority over geometry, timing, typography, and rendering.
Human animation effort should scale with genuinely new visual primitives and renderer topologies, not with the number of generated lessons that compose reviewed primitives.
Dense rendered-frame validation, timeline-wide layout planning, typed repair, and representative human calibration can make established animation families smooth without card-by-card visual tuning.

phases.title: Gold equation reader parity foundation
phases.objective: Transfer the accepted equation choreography into a searchable, scrollable, URL-addressable reader with stable typography, ownership, exact rewind, motion policy, accessibility, responsive containment, and a lightweight production route.

phases.title: Generated equation reliability and gold calibration
phases.objective: Begin with the remaining human-reported gold-card typography, trajectory, handoff, pacing, and boundary defects; convert every accepted repair into a reusable invariant; then compile a stress cohort spanning expression length, signs, fractions, and division with no card-specific motion coordinates or CSS; select one timeline-wide typography and layout plan; densely gate rendered motion, ownership, boundaries, collisions, overflow, focus, accessibility, responsive fit, exact seek, and rewind; and demonstrate a controlled LLM semantic edit that either publishes through reviewed motifs or returns a typed repair.

phases.title: Missing-middle algebra and geometry
phases.objective: Use the promoted generated-equation contracts to coordinate algebraic symbols with a simple geometric representation as the second clarity exemplar.

phases.title: SVG diagrams and graphs
phases.objective: Prove stylistically unified lightweight diagrams and graphs, including KaTeX-compatible labeling and shared focus and salience affordances.

phases.title: Code transformation card
phases.objective: Prove modal flexibility with collapsing, morphing, and refactoring code while preserving semantic identity, deterministic motion, overflow safety, and reviewability.

phases.title: Providers and review modes
phases.objective: Generalize the equation-family provider proof into verified problem generators, LLM providers, flashcards, and correction workflows around stable semantic card and transformation contracts.

phases.title: Cross-domain and WebGL breadth
phases.objective: Demonstrate network, economics, FTC, physics, and lazy WebGL experiences only where their dimensionality materially improves explanation.

approval.rationale: Reconcile terminal gold-parity evidence with the approved generated-reliability frontier: preserve the completed foundation and move human-reported polish plus reusable quality enforcement into the current generated-equation phase.
